title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Dispatch Desk Rule: One Open Job per Loss
content:
> No other fire job of the same customer for the same loss address and the same loss date may be open when a new dispatch is booked. A repeat call about a loss with an open job is handled on that job, a job being open in every status except closed and cancelled. Jobs are never combined for billing: each payment, posting, credit or refund names one job and moves only that job's balance.

This rule governs the booking of a new Fire & Smoke Mitigation dispatch and the way the ledgers of several jobs stay apart.

## The booking test

A new dispatch is tested against the company's own job records, not against the caller's account of them. The test compares three things on the customer's existing fire jobs:

1. the same customer;
2. the same loss address;
3. the same loss date.

A job matching on all three counts against the new booking only if it is open. Open means every status except closed and cancelled:

| Status of the existing matching job | Open? |
|---|---|
| dispatched | yes |
| authorized | yes |
| cleaning | yes |
| cleaning complete | yes |
| invoiced | yes |
| closed | no |
| cancelled | no |

When an open matching job exists, a new dispatch for that loss may not be booked; the repeat call is handled on the open job.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical records)

| Existing job of the same customer | New call | Outcome under the rule |
|---|---|---|
| Same address, same loss date, status invoiced | Another call about that fire | Open job exists: the call is handled on that job |
| Same address, same loss date, status closed | Another call about that fire | No open matching job: the rule does not bar the booking |
| Same address, same loss date, status cancelled | Another call about that fire | No open matching job: the rule does not bar the booking |
| Same address, different loss date, status cleaning | A call about a new fire | Loss date differs: the rule does not bar the booking |
| Different address, same loss date, status authorized | A call about another property | Address differs: the rule does not bar the booking |

## Separate ledgers

Jobs are never combined for billing. Every customer payment, insurance posting, credit or refund names exactly one Fire & Smoke Mitigation job and changes only that job's balance due; an amount recorded on one job does not move the balance of another job, even one of the same customer at the same address.
